scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the equilibrium composition at three hidden radii from the agent's submitted concentration curve via nearest-neighbor lookup; it also verifies structural monotonicity and flat-interface equilibrium. This constitutes a recompute from the raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference concentrations for the Gibbs-Thomson curve at 5.302, 22.195, 92.940 nm, and flat-interface concentration (0.1929).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitised from Figure 3 of the paper (Gibbs-Thomson effect in Pb-Sn at 150°C) and matched to the reference solver's output radii.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper's curve at approximate radii 5, 20, 100 nm; mapped to the exact radii present in the reference solver's 30-point log-spaced list (5.302, 22.195, 92.940 nm) using the paper's trend. Flat-interface concentration 0.1929 is the paper's reported value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These correspond to the paper's published curve and the reference solver's output, ensuring a correct reproduction achieves full reward without inventing arbitrary numbers.

outputs.description: Equilibrium matrix Sn concentration vs precipitate radius for Pb-Sn binary alloy at 150 °C, computed from the paper's algorithm. The hidden checker compares this curve to the paper's reported result with tolerances and checks monotonicity.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that X_B_matrix decreases monotonically with increasing radius, and will compare the values at three hidden radii (e.g., 5 nm, 20 nm, 100 nm) to digitized gold data from the paper's Figure 3, as well as check near flat-interface equilibrium at very large radius. No gold values are provided here.
